reason: A DeepSeek Harness web interface extension centered on five installable themes, with additional task management, SSH and mobile remote access, file and Git panels, and live usage statistics.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供五套可安装主题，并集成任务看板、SSH 远程、移动端访问、文件与 Git 面板及实时统计功能。
summaries.en: Provides five installable themes for DeepSeek Harness Web together with task boards, SSH remote access, mobile controls, file and Git panels, and live usage statistics.

capabilities: Applies five web interface themes with light/dark previews and background adjustment
Provides task-board scheduling and execution through DSH sessions and cron
Provides SSH authentication, web terminal, SFTP, port forwarding, cluster execution, and agent connections
Provides mobile remote session access with model, reasoning, and permission controls
Provides Git graph, file preview, source/preview switching, and SCM operations
Displays live token, TPS, and cache statistics
